seo.title: Which Sport Is It? ⚽🏊 Sports for Kids | Guessing Game for Kids | Unique Kiddo
seo.description:
Can your little one guess the sport from two clues? 🤔 Look at the clues, think, and shout the answer with Kiddo!

A quick sports guessing game for kids. Children learn 4 sports names:
⚽ Football (goal net + running shoes)
🏊 Swimming (goggles + water)
🚴 Cycling (helmet + road)
⛷️ Skiing (snow + mountain)

Each round has think time so kids can guess, and a "say it with me" pause to practise new English words. Great for toddlers, preschool and kindergarten (ages 2–6).

⭐ Subscribe to Unique Kiddo for more fun learning games: animals, vehicles, clothes, letters and more!

Voice: Kokoro TTS (Apache 2.0) · Emoji art: Noto Emoji (Apache 2.0)
